raw_text:
name: dotnet-upgrade
description: .NET framework upgrade analysis/execution.

Prompts:
- Identify/classify all solution projects (.NET Framework/Core/Standard); analyze each `.csproj` `TargetFramework` and SDK usage.
- Review dependencies, graph depth, `packages.config`→`PackageReference`, transitive conflicts/shared strategies.
- Recommend least-to-most-dependent order; isolate libraries before API/Azure Function migrations.
- Plan incremental upgrades with rollback checkpoints; compare **Upgrade Assistant** versus **manual upgrades**.
- Generate build/test/deployment checklists; suggest `TargetFramework` (e.g., `net8.0`); update deprecated SDK/build configurations.
- Identify modernization: `WebHostBuilder`→`HostBuilder`, deprecated APIs/libraries, sync→async, unsupported-library migration paths.
- Analyze YAML SDK pinning; update `UseDotNet@2` and `NuGetToolInstaller`; generate .NET 8 pipelines, feature-branch validation, CI automation.
- Validate builds/runs; execute unit/integration tests; verify logging, telemetry, connectivity, backward compatibility, runtime behavior.
- Recommend UAT/pre-production scenarios; use `.NET Upgrade Assistant` and API Analyzer; recommend replacements and `Startup.cs`→`Program.cs`.
- Create critical endpoint/service regression plans.
